# mtncloud_instance_layout (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud instance layout data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_instance_layout" "ubuntu" {
  name    = "VMware VM"
  version = "22.04"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud instance layout
- `version` (String) The version of the instance layout.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Optional code for use with policies
- `description` (String) The description of the instance layout
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
